en.Se sei qui per la prima volta, è giusto: If you're here for the first time, you should know where I come from.
en.Mi chiamo Pietro Vecchi, sono Biologo Nu: My name is Pietro Vecchi. I'm a Biologist and Nutritionist and the founder of OLTRESOGLIA, the system for people who work under high pressure, have no intention of slowing down as the years go by, but have left their body behind.
en.Per perdere grasso e costruire forza, fi: To lose fat and build strength, stamina and a routine to perform anywhere.
At 14 I was the smallest in the group.
en.Mentre tutti si sviluppavano, io restavo: While everyone else was growing, I was falling behind.
en.Spinto da mio padre, inizio ad allenarmi: Pushed by my father, I started training at the gym to make up for it. I never imagined that something I started so reluctantly would become my passion, and one day my job.
en.A 17 anni, tra la pubertà e ore di allen: At 17, between puberty and hours of training, my body changed. Within a year I went from "the smallest in the group", the one people joked about, to the one with "great genetics".
en.E ho visto in prima persona quanto il co: And I saw first-hand how much your body shapes the way other people see you.
en.La direzione lavorativa arriva con la nu: My career direction came with nutrition and training theory. I became a nutritionist. The work grew, a team soon formed, and I went from doing the work to leading other people every day.
en.Oggi non mi alleno più come a 20 anni, c: Today I don't train the way I did at 20, with free hours and no schedule. I'm not a professional athlete and I don't live like one.
en.Mi alleno dentro una settimana fatta di: I train inside a week made of deadlines, a team to lead, decisions to make, travel and late dinners.
en.Il mondo del coaching e della nutrizione: The world of coaching and nutrition is full of copy-paste workout sheets and plans designed for people with standard, perfect days. So people who live high-pressure weeks jump from one diet to the next, from one program to another, and start over every Monday.
en.Non ti chiediamo di stravolgere la tua s: We don't ask you to turn your week upside down to make room for the plan.
en.Partiamo dai tuoi impegni e cuciamo la s: We start from your commitments and tailor the structure around them: shifts, meetings that run over, last-minute trips and evenings you don't get to decide.
en.Al centro del percorso: At the centre of the journey
en.La nostra missione è offrire a chi scegl: Our mission is to give everyone who chooses OLTRESOGLIA a system built to measure, with a team that knows their commitments, adapts to their schedule and can take over the management of their physique completely.
en.Da ragazzo ho provato calcio e basket, m: As a kid I tried football and basketball, but I wasn't cut out for either.
en.A 16 anni entro in palestra per la prima: At 16 I walked into a gym for the first time, almost out of obligation: I had to find a sport to do.
en.All'inizio era un modo per stare meglio: At first it was a way to feel better in my body. I was introverted and had more than one insecurity. Over time it became the drive to outdo myself, physically and mentally.
In recent years I've added running. And every time I think of my 13-year-old self, who couldn't run a kilometre without stopping. If I could talk to him, I'd tell him to trust himself and never underestimate what you build through consistency.
en.Durante l'istituto tecnico economico ho: At a technical high school for economics, I realised a static office job wasn't for me. That's how I found nutrition.
en.Sono schematico: organizzazione, precisi: I'm structured: organisation, precision, order. I rarely step outside my routines, but I adapt fast.
en.È lo stesso equilibrio che cerco nei per: It's the same balance I look for in the programs I build: a clear structure that holds up even when the week doesn't go to plan.
en.Amo viaggiare e mi affascinano gli sport: I love travelling and I'm fascinated by extreme sports. But even a walk in the fresh air, ideally by the sea, is enough to make me feel alive.
en.Perché faccio il coach? Per aiutare le p: Why do I coach? To help people discover what it means to go beyond their limits.
en.Qui siamo tutti sullo stesso piano. Nien: Here we're all on the same level. No filters, no shortcuts. What makes the difference is effort, repeated over time.
en.Lo sport ha sempre fatto parte della mia: Sport has always been part of my life. I tried several disciplines, but I often felt that all that effort wasn't paid back by results.
en.Da adolescente ho lasciato gli sport di: As a teenager I left team sports for the gym. I wanted a challenge where the result depended mostly on me, my effort and my consistency.
en.In poco tempo è diventata una passione,: It quickly became a passion, and training became the happy moment of my day.
en.Per anni mi sono dedicata al bodybuildin: For years I dedicated myself to bodybuilding. Today I alternate weights with aerobic work. I like feeling strong and having a body that is efficient, capable and ready for different challenges.
en.Nel mio percorso ho attraversato momenti: Along the way I went through moments that taught me how much it matters to know your body, respect it and look after it. That's where my choice to study Sports Science and Nutrition Science came from, and to turn a passion into a profession.
I'm methodical, determined and rational. I like having a direction and understanding the why behind what I do. But I've learned that not everything goes to plan. Adapting, allowing yourself an exception and getting straight back on track is part of the journey.
en.È lo stesso approccio che porto nel lavo: It's the same approach I bring to my work. No journey is a straight line: there are climbs, descents, bends and moments when you need to slow down. What counts is to keep heading in the right direction, even in the weeks that don't go as planned.
en.Per questo voglio conoscere davvero la p: That's why I want to really get to know the person in front of me and build a program that works in their everyday life, not just on paper.
en.Diventare coach è stata una delle scelte: Becoming a coach was one of the most important choices I've made. It makes me happy to walk alongside people who decide to challenge themselves, towards goals that seemed far away, beyond the limits they had set themselves.
en.Fin da piccolo ho avuto una forte passio: Since I was little I've had a strong passion for sport, especially football. I was overweight, but inside I already had a huge desire to improve. Sport was the first thing that taught me to challenge myself and work on myself.
en.Non ero il più pronto né il più avvantag: I wasn't the most ready or the most gifted. But I had something that would become a fixed point: the ability to commit, fall, get back up and keep going.
en.Due infortuni importanti alle ginocchia: Two serious knee injuries put that mindset to the test. I had to come back, start again and find my old feel, more than once. Over time I realised my passion was changing, and accepting that wasn't easy.
en.La disciplina però è rimasta, ed è diven: The discipline stayed, though, and became the foundation of my next choices.
en.Ho superato il concorso nell'esercito e: I passed the army entrance exam and went through two years of intensive training. There I learned that strength isn't only about holding on: it's also knowing how to lead yourself when everything around you is testing you.
en.Poi il concorso in Polizia di Stato e ci: Then the State Police exam and five years on patrol. Difficult situations, all kinds of people, tension and responsibility every day. They shaped me as a man, even before as a professional.
en.So cosa significa lavorare sotto pressio: I know what it means to work under pressure, day after day.
en.Eppure sentivo che mancava qualcosa. Ave: And yet I felt something was missing. I had discipline, experience, mental structure and the will to help others. What I lacked was the most authentic way to do it.
en.Con la lettura e un percorso di crescita: Through reading and a path of personal growth I began to look at myself with more awareness. And I realised that the direction I'd been searching for far away had always been right in front of me.
en.Per me oggi essere coach significa unire: For me, being a coach today means bringing together everything I've lived: sport, discipline, obstacles, rebuilding, hard work and mental growth.
en.L'allenamento non è solo un mezzo per ca: Training isn't just a way to change your body. It's a tool to build identity, inner strength and a different way of facing life.
en.Ogni persona ha dentro molto più di quel: Everyone has much more inside than they think. My job is to help them bring it out.
en.Ho praticato calcio, rugby, pugilato e a: I played football, rugby, boxing and other sports for most of my life.
en.Allenatori e preparatori mi dicevano che: Coaches and trainers told me I had real athletic qualities. I was strong, a high performer, often among those who physically handled the workload best. I also took up powerlifting, eventually winning two podium places in competition.
And yet there was a contradiction.
en.Per quanto fossi allenato, nel mio corpo: However well trained I was, I didn't really feel at ease in my body.
en.Le situazioni più normali, come il mare,: The most ordinary situations, like the beach, the pool or taking my shirt off in front of others, made me more uncomfortable than I wanted to admit. Nothing huge, but it was a constant feeling. That little voice that makes you pick the loose T-shirt instead of the fitted one, or makes you feel watched when probably no one is looking.
en.Per anni ho pensato che bastasse essere: For years I thought being strong was enough. It isn't.
en.La sicurezza non nasce solo da quello ch: Confidence doesn't only come from what your body can do. It also comes from the relationship you have with it.
en.So cosa vuol dire essere bravo in un cam: I know what it's like to be good in one area and not feel right in another.
en.È questo che mi ha portato a studiare l': That's what led me to study training. Not out of academic interest, but to find practical answers to a very personal question: how to build a physique that made me feel strong and athletic, but also in line with the image I had of myself.
en.Ho studiato e sperimentato fino a trovar: I studied and experimented until I found my answer. Today I help other people find theirs.
en.Lo sport fa parte della mia vita da semp: Sport has always been part of my life. As a child I did swimming and jiu-jitsu, and even then I knew sitting still wasn't for me.
en.A nove anni è arrivato il calcio, nella: At nine came football, with my hometown team. I never stopped and I still play today. That team gave me more than a sport: it gave me the friends I still have now.
en.Il 2019 ha cambiato la direzione. Mi all: 2019 changed my direction. I was training at home, with no plan and without really knowing what I was doing. And yet my body was changing, and that hooked me. I realised that curiosity deserved a method, and that the method could become my job.
Then the crossroads: training or nutrition. I didn't choose, and followed both paths. That's what lets me see the whole person today.
en.Sono organizzato e metodico. Ma lo schem: I'm organised and methodical. But the structure is there for me. The program has to fit into the real life of the people I coach, with their job, their hours and their dinners out.
en.Non credo nei piani perfetti che crollan: I don't believe in perfect plans that collapse after the first bad week. I believe in the ones that hold up for months.
en.Fuori dal lavoro viaggio, scopro posti n: Outside work I travel, discover new places and spend time with friends. Or I simply watch a match with others.
en.Quello che mi tiene legato a questo lavo: What keeps me in this work is simple: I like helping people. There's no greater satisfaction than seeing someone get to where they were sure they couldn't.
en.Perché il cambiamento vero non riguarda: Because real change isn't only about the body. It's about the trust a person has in themselves.
en.Per chi pretende dal proprio corpo lo st: For those who demand the same level from their body that they demand from everything else.
